title.en: Income Tax (Assignment of Functions under Section 3A — Monetary Authority of Singapore) Notification 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en:
1. This Notification is the Income Tax (Assignment of Functions under Section 3A — Monetary Authority of Singapore) Notification 2022 and comes into operation on 6 December 2022.
[S 74/2026 wef 23/02/2026]
